properties.name: vanillabp.adapters.process-engine-api.fetch-variables
properties.description: Removed in 2.0. A start which still sets it ends with a message, at this level and at 'vanillabp.workflow-modules.<module>.adapters.<id>.fetch-variables' and the levels below it. This works for every adapter id of type 'process-engine-api', not only for the id 'process-engine-api'.

deprecation.reason: A subscription now always asks for the variables VanillaBP reads. A handler which needs more reads it from the workflow aggregate.
